claims.claim: TS2Vec learns timestamp-level multiscale representations with hierarchical contrastive learning and reports anomaly-detection use.
claims.title: TS2Vec: Towards Universal Representation of Time Series
claims.contradiction: Published anomaly protocol is point-oriented and does not prove P1 long-event F1 improvement.
claims.remaining_gap: Historical long-event qualification with fixed FP/day and event support gates.

claims.claim: ClaSP creates a self-supervised classification score profile for change-point proposals.
claims.publisher: Springer Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery
claims.title: ClaSP: parameter-free time series segmentation
claims.contradiction: Normal ocean regime shifts may be stronger than injected event boundaries.
claims.remaining_gap: Use only after TS2Vec failure and verify paired event boundaries.

claims.claim: BayOTIDE decomposes multivariate series into functional low-rank factors with GP-to-SDE state-space inference and uncertainty.
claims.title: BayOTIDE: Bayesian Online Multivariate Time Series Imputation with Functional Decomposition
claims.contradiction: Published missingness is not the same as a 61-day target-channel blackout.
claims.remaining_gap: Actual-depth joint T/S block-mask validation against the strongest common OOF.

claims.claim: ImputeFormer combines low-rank inductive bias with temporal and cross-channel attention for block-missing imputation.
claims.title: ImputeFormer: Low Rankness-Induced Transformers for Generalizable Spatiotemporal Imputation
claims.contradiction: Node embeddings would mis-handle P2 layer-number/depth changes without a non-original modification.

claims.claim: TimeXer separates endogenous patch self-attention from exogenous variate cross-attention and reports broad forecasting gains.
claims.title: TimeXer: Empowering Transformers for Time Series Forecasting with Exogenous Variables
claims.contradiction: Benchmarks are not three-station wave cases and can include future covariates unavailable to P3.
claims.remaining_gap: Past-only direct six-lead nested validation with seed and long-lead gates.

claims.claim: Wave action balance provides physical motivation for Hs-squared source/sink trajectory regularization.
claims.publisher: SWAN Team, Delft University of Technology
claims.title: SWAN technical documentation: action balance, wind input, dissipation
claims.contradiction: P3 lacks wave spectra, spatial flux, bathymetry and future wind.
claims.remaining_gap: Second-line bounded residual only, not a SWAN surrogate claim.

claims.claim: The public organizer homepage currently shows 2026-09-30 as the university preliminary end and result-submission deadline.
claims.publisher: 2026 Ocean Science AI Big Data Competition organizer
claims.title: 2026 해양과학 AI·빅데이터 경진대회
claims.contradiction: Repository notes retain an older 2026-09-07 deadline and authenticated notices may contain more specific rules.
claims.remaining_gap: Recheck authenticated notice and problem detail before any final action.
